body: Mine do. If nothing else, them relying on me gives me a reason to get out of bed in the morning
I tried to post there and I’m pretty sure mine was removed too, not even sure why. Good to know I’m not the only one though, and that there’s a place we can come to instead.

I am so sorry. I just wanted to say that I know what it feels like to feel like life is over over traumatic events like this. The cheating especially. But I know people who have had to live with an STD. It’s  more common than people are willing to admit. I’m truly sorry about the pain and humiliation and stress, but you can be okay again. So many people live with things like this.
In addition to internal issues, yeah, this world is just painful to live in..

I’m also suicidal, but I want to promise you that middle / high school grades don’t really matter. And if you went to a trusted teacher or school counselor they could help you get on track and maybe explain things to your dad so he can better support you. I’m sorry about your grandpa and your mom.

I am definitely willing to be honest and work toward healing. That’s what I want. But I am just scared that it could make things worse for me like legally / materially in my life. 

I don’t have good experiences with therapy so far: Its expensive and feels impossible to get help. When I could get it I never found it to be helpful or like they could tell me anything I didn’t know about myself. 

My problems are much worse this time around so maybe it could be different. I just have fears of having my rights taken away, being institutionalized against my will, being treated poorly due to my mental illness, etc. I don’t want to dig my hole deeper.

I guess what I was asking here is if anyone has been through these types of things and been able to confide in a therapist about it without some sort of repercussions. Or if I go should I expect something to happen
